content.title: Queue PDF exports from each export action
content.test_md_blob:
# Queue PDF exports from each export action

> Prove the export format can be changed from the default to PDF before queuing any export action and a success toast is shown.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} and land on the portfolio dashboard view where the Export control is available.

## Step 2

Open the Export popover and verify the Format section initially shows CSV selected with JSON and PDF also available.

## Step 3

Change the selected export format to PDF and verify PDF is now the selected format.

## Step 4

Queue Export Current View, Export Holdings, Export Transactions, and Export Risk Report one at a time with PDF left selected; after each selection, confirm a success toast appears for the queued export action and reopen the Export popover if it closes before the next action.

## Step 5 — assert @verifies ac-127, ac-118, ac-119, ac-120, ac-121, ac-122, ac-123, ac-124, ac-125

Confirm absolute check: PDF (equals) — the stated promise: If PDF is selected as the target format, PDF is the selected export format when the export action is queued.
